result.title: From Point Clouds to Engineering Models: Benchmarking Agentic 3D Reconstruction in the Built Environment
result.summary: Coding agents can translate 3D measurements into CAD geometry, but reconstructing engineering models for the built environment demands semantic interpretation and consistent construction constraints beyond surface fitting. We formulate scene-level Scan-to-BIM (Building Information Modeling) as an agentic 3D coding task and introduce S2Bench, comprising public and proprietary scans of 128 real-world scenes across five domains, paired with expert-curated reference models spanning diverse spatial scales. A shared framework lets agents measure scans in Python, build class-labeled components in a live CAD/BIM kernel, and iteratively refine their code. We also propose parallel asynchronous collaboration, where a lead delegates versioned tasks, continues modeling while workers execute, and integrates revision-bound proposals. Evaluating five agents and a collaborative team across 1,028 reconstructions shows that scan-to-model residuals directly guide geometric repair, whereas inferring semantic classes and construction relations requires joint geometric, visual, and engineering reasoning that agents struggle to ground and verify. Consequently, the leading agent fits scan geometry closely ($96\%$ coverage within $5\,\text{cm}$) yet reaches only $63\%$ mIoU, and no agent passes all engineering checks on more than $38\%$ of scenes. Coverage and engineering conformance drop with scene scale, whereas running a smaller model as a team improves all three axes with greater coverage gains on larger scenes. The project page is available at https://tumcms.github.io/S2Bench.github.io/

AI.brief_summary: 论文将场景级 Scan-to-BIM 形式化为 agentic 3D 编码任务，构建覆盖 128 个真实场景的 S2Bench，让编码 agent 在 Python 中测量点云、在 CAD/BIM 内核中构建语义构件并迭代修改代码，同时提出由 lead 分派带版本任务、并行异步整合修订提案的协作方式，并评测多个 agent 与一个协作团队。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「扫描残差直接引导几何修复」与带版本任务分派、修订绑定整合的并行协作机制，可能为 LVR 的并行生成、状态更新与贡献分配提供可核查线索；但对象是点云到工程 CAD 模型的重建而非视觉推理内部状态，与主线的距离需进一步判断。
